videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and automatic translations depend on the original platform; complete Traditional Chinese captions are not guaranteed.
videos.scope: 本課「電子束直接寫入」的延伸背景。辨認曝光系統的光學、載台與整合規模；動畫為導覽，不是組裝施工圖。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Electron-beam direct writing. Identify the optics, stages and integration scale of an exposure system; the animation is a tour, not assembly drawings. It is not footage of every step in this course.
watchFor: 找出光罩與晶圓所處的不同位置。
觀察光學系統與精密運動系統如何配合。
把解析度能力與層間對準能力分開記錄。
watchForEn: Locate the distinct positions of mask and wafer.
Observe cooperation between optics and precision motion.
Record resolution capability separately from layer-to-layer alignment.
videos.before: 先問：「把設計版圖轉成可寫入圖元」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Convert layout into writable primitives requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「以多個標記擬合平移旋轉」列為查證任務：標記配置決定可辨識的誤差類型。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Fit translation and rotation using several marks: Mark geometry determines identifiable errors. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

courses.summary: 電子束直接寫入涉及跨國材料、設備與量測合作。本課程地圖選用NIST Gaithersburg／CNST NanoFab 園區代表點作為公開研究或設備技術的代表位置。課程練習以公開原理連結圖形、材料與驗證，不宣稱此處為唯一發明地、所有技術的生產工廠或實際機台位置。
courses.summaryEn: Electron-beam direct writing involves international collaboration in materials, equipment and metrology. The map uses NIST Gaithersburg / CNST NanoFab campus reference as a public research or equipment-technology reference. Exercises connect patterns, materials and validation through public principles; this is not claimed to be the sole invention site, a factory producing every technology, or an instrument location.

history.title: CNST 成立
history.text: NIST 原始文章記錄 CNST 在 2007 年 5 月成立，連結奈米製造與量測。
history.textEn: The NIST original article records CNST establishment in May 2007, linking nanofabrication and measurement.

history.title: NanoFab 重新向研究使用者開放
history.text: NIST 公告設施重新開放，介紹微影、蝕刻、沉積與表徵的共同工作。
history.textEn: NIST announced reopening and described complementary lithography, etch, deposition and characterization work.

courses.connection: 比較相關課程時，逐項追蹤材料、圖案形成方式、誤差與驗收證據的差異；相似原理不表示配方可直接移植。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related courses by materials, pattern formation, errors and acceptance evidence. Similar principles do not make recipes directly transferable.
